title: Labby Code Mode Retained Slice Request
description: Parameters accepted by the sandbox helper `codemode.slice(handle, path, range)`, dispatched host-side as `__lab_internal::codemode_result_slice`.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer selecting a sub-value of the retained root. The empty string selects the root. `~0` escapes `~`, `~1` escapes `/`.

range.description: Optional bounded window applied to the value AT `path`. Legal only when that value is an array or a string; applying a range to an object, number, boolean, or null is a `retained_slice_invalid` error. Semantics follow Array.prototype.slice: indices clamp to bounds, and start >= end yields an empty result rather than an error. For strings, indices count Unicode scalar values (chars), never bytes, so a slice can never split a multi-byte character.

end.description: Exclusive upper bound. Defaults to the array length or string char-length.
